rv.q: It might not be enough for this show.
But the play's episodic nature is too much tell, not enough show.
The play feels revelant and lovingly manifest.
With intentional casting and whimsical performances, this production will be a treat for audiences.
But the production’s push-and-pull ultimately frustrates.

cn.t: Taylor Mac dazzles in this whimsical revival of Ruhl's adaptation, though critics find the production uneven—some praise its joyful embrace of fluidity and spectacle, while others feel it doesn't fully capitalize on its timely themes or vast stage.
